blocks.text: Rap icon Gloc-9 is nearing 50 and has almost 30 years in the music scene under his belt, yet he would be the first one to prove that growth never stops. At a recent media huddle for his new single “Tara G!” with an online gaming platform, the OPM star talked about his latest creative work. Instead of treating it as a normal brand tie-up, he saw it as a test to try something fresh.
